name: VOB 2019 — Procurement and Contract Regulations for Construction
description: Validates tender and contract documents against the Vergabe- und Vertragsordnung fuer Bauleistungen (VOB) 2019 edition. Covers Part A (procurement for public contracts), Part B (general contract conditions) and Part C (technical specifications per DIN 18299 ff.). Checks mandatory clauses, deadlines, ATV trade references, measurement rules and LV description rules per VOB/A paragraph 7.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: DVA (Deutscher Vergabe- und Vertragsausschuss fuer Bauleistungen)
